body_markdown:
**Do you have questions about the promotion of Service Bridge configurations? Well you're in the right place.**


This is an update to the blog post[Service Bridge for Providers/Consumers - promoting configurations from dev/test/prod](https://www.servicenow.com/community/technology-blog/service-bridge-for-providers-consumers-promoting-configurations/ba-p/2856428) and has been moved into a Support KB article found here[Service Bridge Instance Promotion Best Practices prior to August'24 Store Release.](https://support.servicenow.com/kb?id=kb_article_view&sysparm_article=KB1649163)


Note: This applies to Service Bridge for Providers v1 and Service Bridge for Consumers v1 apps which were released in November 2023.
